import itertools
import networkx as nx

def solve_for_n(n):
    # All permutations of 0..n-1
    perms = list(itertools.permutations(range(n)))
    
    # Build the graph
    G = nx.Graph()
    for p in perms:
        G.add_node(p)
        # Neighbors: swaps of adjacent vertices (i, i+1 mod n)
        for i in range(n):
            p_list = list(p)
            j = (i + 1) % n
            p_list[i], p_list[j] = p_list[j], p_list[i]
            G.add_edge(p, tuple(p_list))
    
    # Distance matrix for S_n
    dist = dict(nx.all_pairs_shortest_path_length(G))
    
    # Orbits under rotation
    orbits = []
    visited = set()
    for p in perms:
        if p not in visited:
            orbit = []
            curr = p
            for _ in range(n):
                orbit.append(curr)
                visited.add(curr)
                # Rotate current permutation: (p0, p1, ..., pn-1) -> (p1, ..., pn-1, p0)
                curr = curr[1:] + (curr[0],)
            orbits.append(orbit)
            
    # Distance between orbits
    max_min_dist = 0
    for i in range(len(orbits)):
        for j in range(i + 1, len(orbits)):
            min_dist = float('inf')
            for p1 in orbits[i]:
                for p2 in orbits[j]:
                    min_dist = min(min_dist, dist[p1][p2])
            max_min_dist = max(max_min_dist, min_dist)
            
    return max_min_dist

for n in range(3, 7):
    print(f"N={n}, max_min_dist={solve_for_n(n)}")
